suite: Browser client 2.2: UI + server snapshot fixture, NOT real Socket.IO

results.name: Actual menu button triggers exactly one click cue
Canvas and hotkeys do not produce button-click sounds
Player 2 snapshot gives control of Player 2, not host
Opponent is marked as enemy in Player 2 view
Client cannot advance gameplay when server snapshots stop
Player 2 sees its own factory rather than host factory
Online production sends command, never gives local ammunition
Online player has the same launch button picker
Online pause menu explains that match clock remains shared
Masked remote missile can be rendered without private source/target
Foreign room snapshots cannot replace the current match
Disconnect banner appears and local presentation freezes
Room lobby displays two seats and six-character invite code
Host start stays disabled until BOTH seats are ready
Room lobby fits 360px viewport without horizontal overflow
Late snapshots cannot restart gameplay after leaving a room
No unhandled errors in offline buttons, Player 2 view and room UI
